npships.data_help.type.1: Byte: whole number from -128 to 127, with suffix b (for example 1b). A byte is not necessarily a yes/no setting.
npships.data_help.type.2: Short integer: -32768 to 32767, suffix s; example 10s.
npships.data_help.type.3: Integer: a whole number without a suffix, for example 10. The mod may impose additional limits.
npships.data_help.type.4: Long integer: a whole number with suffix L; example 100L.
npships.data_help.type.5: Float: a number with a decimal point and suffix f; example 1.5f. Use a dot, not a comma.
npships.data_help.type.6: Double: a number with suffix d; example 1.5d. The suffix preserves its stored type.
npships.data_help.type.7: Byte array: [B;1b,2b]. Entries must be bytes.
npships.data_help.type.8: Text: write it in quotes, for example "text". Escape a quote inside the text with a backslash.
npships.data_help.type.9: List: values inside [ ], separated by commas. All entries have the same NBT type; for example [1,2,3].
npships.data_help.type.10: Group: named fields inside { }, for example {name:"text",count:1}. Hover a nested field to inspect it.
npships.data_help.type.11: Integer array: [I;1,2,3]. Entries are whole numbers.
npships.data_help.sample_short: Value (abbreviated; edit the full text in the field): %s
npships.data_help.structure_scope: Known saved/default fields, not a complete mod schema. Examples do not define limits; NBT alone cannot reveal gameplay limits.

npships.configuration.automatic.tooltip: Automatic spawning, player safety, rarity and excluded structures.
npships.configuration.rarity.tooltip: Relative selection weights and player pressure. These are not independent admission probabilities or a guaranteed spawn rate.
npships.configuration.lifecycle.tooltip: Cleanup of tracked physical structures after they unload. Does not force loaded structures to unload.
npships.configuration.limits.tooltip: Search budgets and safety limits. Yellow settings apply after reopening the world or restarting the server.
npships.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Allow automatic spawn attempts. Does not reset the timer or cancel a placement already in progress.
npships.configuration.min_player_structu: Minimum 3D clearance from every eligible player to final automatic placement. Default 64 blocks; boundary allowed, 0 = off. Live; separate from initial-point distance.
npships.configuration.max_player_structu: Require a player within this horizontal distance of the structure. -1 derives the distance from simulation range plus allowance; 0 disables the limit. Both original and rotated bounds are checked.
npships.configuration.player_relevance_e: Extra distance allowed between the player and structure only when the maximum is -1. Default 256 blocks; 0 adds none. Does not enlarge the search area or rarity field.
npships.configuration.pivot_blocks.toolt: Non-air block count where the size curve switches to the tail exponent. Raising it extends the main size curve to larger structures.
npships.configuration.scale_blocks.toolt: Non-air block count with 50% base preference when it is below the pivot. Increasing it generally favors larger structures.
npships.configuration.size_exponent.tool: Controls size preference up to the pivot. Increasing it favors structures below the scale and penalizes those above it; the scale itself stays at 50%. Manual rarity overrides are unchanged.
npships.configuration.tail_exponent.tool: Controls the rarity decline above the pivot. Higher values make larger structures less preferred.
npships.configuration.pressure_half_life: Ticks for new pressure events to lose half their strength. Higher values slow recovery. Events expire after 12 half-lives; existing events keep their saved rate. Offline time does not count.
How strongly nearby successful spawns reduce local rarity. Higher values suppress repeats more; 0 disables this reduction. A sole eligible structure still wins the selection.
npships.configuration.maximum_pressure.t: Maximum pressure per player and dimension. Success fills only the remaining capacity; excess is discarded. 0 disables pressure. Overlapping fields use the strongest value.
npships.configuration.field_extra_blocks: Additional spherical field radius in blocks beyond the server simulation radius. 0 removes only the addition. Pressure is constant inside each field.
npships.configuration.opportunity_interv: Inclusive base delay in ticks, divided by sqrt(players) up to the configured cap. Floor: 2400 ticks or a shorter configured minimum. Next deadline draw only.
Inclusive base maximum in ticks. Below minimum uses minimum. Player scaling still applies; existing deadlines stay.
npships.configuration.disabled_addons.to: Exclude resource namespaces from autospawn; manual placement remains. Structure toggles cannot override this.
npships.configuration.disabled_structure: Exact namespace:path IDs excluded from automatic spawning. Manual placement remains available. Also editable in Installed structures.
npships.configuration.entity_cleanup_whi: Entity IDs preserved during physical-structure cleanup. Players are always kept. No wildcards; IDs of absent mods are allowed. Applies to the next cleanup.
Unload grace: default 300 seconds; 0 = none. Does not force unloading or change deadlines already set.
npships.configuration.recent_spawn_coold: Base cooldown multiplied by the square root of eligible players, up to the configured cap. Default 3600 ticks (3 min). Existing expiry times stay unchanged.
npships.configuration.recent_spawn_playe: Recent-success exclusion around the reference player: default 1000 blocks. Not a structure count cap.
npships.configuration.max_structures_per: Weighted draws per attempt: 1–8, default 8. Repeats consume a slot without a new search. Placement not guaranteed.
npships.configuration.max_physical_overl: Physical-overlap retries: default 3; 0 disables. Collision checks stay active.
npships.configuration.max_search_operati: Search operations per server tick: default 24000. Higher may cost more tick time, not raise selection chance.
npships.configuration.max_scan_checks_pe: Scanning checks per server tick; default 24000. Higher values let more checks run in one tick and may increase server load. Does not relax placement rules.
npships.configuration.max_chunk_operatio: Chunk-operation budget per server tick; default 16. Larger values may increase loading/tick cost.
npships.configuration.min_horizontal_rad: Initial search radius: default 24 blocks. May expand to maximum; environment/height rules remain.
npships.configuration.max_horizontal_rad: Maximum horizontal search radius around the initial point; default 128 blocks.
npships.configuration.min_vertical_radiu: Initial vertical search radius: default 16 blocks. World/author height bounds remain.
npships.configuration.max_vertical_radiu: Maximum vertical search radius in blocks; default 96. Does not change AIR preset heights or world bounds.
npships.configuration.min_player_horizon: Minimum horizontal distance from the player to the initial search point; default 64 blocks. Final placement safety is checked separately.
npships.configuration.max_player_horizon: Maximum horizontal distance from the player to the initial search point. 0 derives it from server simulation distance; a positive value specifies blocks. Final placement safety is checked separately.
npships.configuration.player_simulation_: Inset from the calculated simulation boundary: default 16 blocks; 0 = boundary itself.
npships.configuration.min_effective_simu: Minimum simulation radius used in calculations (chunks)
NPShips calculation floor: default 2 chunks. Does not change Minecraft simulation distance.
npships.configuration.search_chunk_margi: Extra ring of chunks around final placement; default 0. Does not change post-spawn protection or chunk loading required by other mods.
npships.configuration.natural_physical_l: Keep spawned physical structures loaded for this many ticks; default 1200 (1 min at 20 TPS). 0 disables extra protection. Existing protection expiry times stay unchanged.
Camera sensitivity; default 0.6. First-person sensitivity is half this value. Applies to the next camera movement.
npships.configuration.zoom_step.tooltip: Zoom multiplier per wheel step; default 1.15, range 1.01–2.0. Applies to the next zoom action.
npships.configuration.inspector_preferre: Inspector width in GUI units; 0 selects automatically. Clamped to the screen. Drag the divider, or reopen the editor after editing this value.

npships.configuration.resources.tooltip: Limits on search, chunk loading, generated mobs and accounted memory. Higher limits allow larger jobs but may increase server load.
npships.configuration.resources.max_targ: Maximum distinct target chunks inspected by one attempt, including retries. Higher values allow wider searches; exceeding the limit refuses the attempt.
npships.configuration.resources.max_depe: Maximum distinct chunk positions needed for physical assembly. Overlaps count once. Exceeding the limit refuses the operation before loading this set. Higher values allow larger assemblies.
npships.configuration.resources.max_owne: Maximum chunks NPShips may hold loaded at once. Required chunks stay loaded until placement finishes. Chunks held by other mods are counted separately.
npships.configuration.resources.max_conc: Maximum not-yet-ready target chunks requested at once. Other targets wait. Higher values may speed loading at a greater server cost.
npships.configuration.resources.max_ever: Total distinct not-yet-ready chunks allowed over one attempt. 0 removes this total limit; concurrent loading is still bounded. Exceeding a positive limit refuses the attempt.
npships.configuration.resources.working_: Accounted working memory shared by active operations, in MiB. 0 uses one eighth of the JVM maximum heap. Exceeding the budget refuses new work. This does not bound all memory used by Minecraft or other mods.
npships.configuration.resources.max_gene: Maximum requested mobs per composed schematic, including failed attempts to place them. 0 allows none. Excess refuses the operation instead of trimming the pool. Authored entities are separate.
npships.configuration.resources.max_crew: Maximum entity-validation calls per composed schematic. Repeated checks and every member of an entity tag count. Raising this allows larger mob pools but may increase load.
Total counted mob-placement work. 0 records work without this extra cutoff; positive values refuse jobs that exceed it. This is a work count, not milliseconds.
npships.configuration.resources.chunk_st: Maximum game ticks waiting for the same unready chunk. 0 waits without this timeout. Other chunk progress does not reset it; paused time does not count.
npships.configuration.resources.catalogu: Accounted payload and metadata budget for one catalogue, in MiB. 0 uses one thirty-second of the JVM maximum heap. An oversized replacement keeps the previous catalogue.
Shared budget for current, replacing and still-used catalogues, in MiB. 0 uses one sixteenth of the JVM maximum heap. Lower values limit simultaneous catalogue versions.
